claims.statement: When Hibernate Validator is on the classpath the inspector lists validations that can be applied to the selected attribute.
claims.supports: section lists validations that can be applied to the selected attribute
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Headless on the BEHAVIOUR: code action 'Add validation constraint with preview…' lists the constraints that fit the picked attribute's type. Not checked: the original's JPA Inspector section, and the 'when Hibernate Validator is on the classpath' condition (ours does not read the classpath).

claims.statement: Validation annotations can be added to entity attributes from JPA Designer.
claims.supports: adds validation annotations to entity attributes (JPA Designer)
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Headless on the BEHAVIOUR: code action 'Add validation constraint with preview…' adds the chosen Bean Validation annotation (with its import) to the attribute. Not checked: the original's JPA Designer surface.
